lots.guide_summary: All sold: three close Gowans hammer results for 9ct bracelets of 7.9 to 10.2g, $500 to $725 (Dec 2025 to May 2026), premium extra. Lighter 9ct bracelets ($220 to $370) give a $59 to $80/g hammer band, so 8.9g points to about $525 to $710. No unsold or verified asking evidence survives. Melt check (goldpricez.com page opened 2026-10-21: 24K $188.74/g AUD, so 9ct at 37.5% is about $70.78/g): 8.9g is about $630 melt, a floor that a gold buyer would pay perhaps 85 to 90% of. All AUD, rate 1.0.
lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD = $500 (7.9g, Dec 2025) / 1.198 = $417.36, down to $415 (all-in about $497, well under the roughly $630 melt for 8.9g).
